rows.description: 🤖 Open-source, local-first alternative to Grok Bot, OpenAI dots and Claude Duet. Your own AI bots on any model: GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM and 70+ more through one Modelflare key. Reach them in the app, WeChat or Feishu; they remember you, work in the background, run commands and use your computer. Pay per use.

在 dsh 里装上这个插件即可，无需登录、注册或填 API Key，就能使用包括 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash、Kimi K3 在内的前沿模型——完全免费，不限量。 All you do is install this plugin in dsh: no login, no sign-up, no API key — the frontier models are just there, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and Kimi K3 among them. Completely free, with no usage cap.
Your lightweight open-source personal agent.

Open-source, high-performance AI gateway that works as your LLM gateway, MCP gateway and agent gateway. One OpenAI-compatible API for 10,000+ models, with failover, load balancing, semantic caching, virtual keys, budgets and MCP Code Mode. Works with any SDK or agent and adds under 200µs of overhead at 5k RPS.
The free AI already on your Mac. CLI tool, OpenAI-compatible server, and interactive chat — all on-device via Apple Intelligence. No API keys, no cloud, no downloads.
Local-first AI agent workspace for coding, writing, design, research, and automation — one runtime for desktop GUI and TUI.
⚡ Pure-Rust WebGPU inference engine — OpenAI-API compatible, GGUF native, runs on any GPU. No Python. No llama.cpp. Single binary.
Model router for agentic systems. Routes every prompt to the right model in <50ms. Cut costs 40-70% with just an endpoint change.

Rapid-MLX is an open-source (Apache 2.0) OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible LLM inference server for Apple Silicon, built on MLX, focused on reliable tool calling for coding agents. Up to 4× faster than Apple's MLX (mlx-lm) on the same weights.
A self-hosted CPA / CLIProxyAPI management panel and AI gateway observability dashboard for requests, usage, cost, quota, failures, and account health.
Open-source GEO content engineering and multi-site distribution platform with AI quality inspection, illustrated admin help, hosted sites, browser-assisted publishing, and signed updates.
FuXi is a fast, self-contained AI coding agent that lives in your terminal — edit code, run commands, and drive tools, with cost-aware routing across LLM providers.

Turn Windsurf / Devin Desktop's 100+ AI models (Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM, SWE) into OpenAI-, Anthropic- & Gemini-compatible APIs. Zero-dependency self-hosted reverse proxy for Claude Code, Cline & Cursor. 把 Windsurf/Devin 云端 100+ 模型变成三套兼容 API。

The fastest way to run Qwen 3.8 Flash Next, Qwen 3.8 27B and Ternary Bonsai 2 27B on a Mac: 125 tok/s in OpenCode on an M5 Max, and a 27B model on 16 GB Macs. Native MTP speculative decoding on Apple Silicon, exact at any temperature. OpenAI and Anthropic compatible local server.
VCP 部署在 AI 模型 API 与前端应用之间，是面向AGI OS开发和探索的工业级基建示范项目。通过统一指令协议、多层级持久化记忆、分布式插件引擎及多 Agent 协作框架，将原本“无状态、无记忆、无工具调用能力”的大语言模型，彻底改造成拥有永久自我意识、物理世界操作权及群体协作智能的完整智能体系统。

High-performance OpenAI and Anthropic compatible LLM inference server for Apple Silicon. Native MLX, continuous batching, multimodal models, MCP tool calling, and Claude Code support.

OpenClaw alternative in your pocket

AI gateway / AI control plane / AI proxy written in Go. Unified OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic-compatible API for OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Groq, xAI, Ollama, vLLM and more. A LiteLLM alternative with observability, guardrails, streaming, cost tracking, intelligent routing, sticky sessions, failover, real-time logs and usage tracking. Prod ready.

Self-hosted search gateway for AI agents. Unified search, news and page extraction with provider fallback. REST API, MCP server and TypeScript library.
